LESSON: JOSEPH INTERPRETS A DREAM

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Holy Bible
Topic 2.5: Joseph interprets a Dream

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Joseph interprets a Dream. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How was Joseph able to interpret dreams?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. retell the story of Joseph interpreting a dream,
2. apply lessons learnt by depending on God’s wisdom,
3. recognise that, ‘the fear of God is the beginning of wisdom.’ The learner is guided to: try to interpret them, and colour it, How was Joseph able to interpret dreams?

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. retell the story of Joseph interpreting a dream,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to retell the story of Joseph interpreting a dream,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. apply lessons learnt by depending on God’s wisdom,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to apply lessons learnt by depending on God’s wisdom,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. recognise that, ‘the fear of God is the beginning of wisdom.’ The learner is guided to: try to interpret them, and colour it, How was Joseph able to interpret dreams?
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to recognise that, ‘the fear of God is the beginning of wisdom.’ The learner is guided to: try to interpret them, and colour it, How was Joseph able to interpret dreams?. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Joseph interprets a Dream.
2. Explain Joseph interprets a Dream to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: read Genesis 41:14-24, 28-30 in turns
4. Show that you can: retell the story of Joseph interpreting a dream,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Joseph interprets a Dream. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: How was Joseph able to interpret dreams?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read Genesis 41:14-24, 28-30 in turns
2. Draw a picture of Joseph before Pharaoh and colour it,
3. Sing a song related to this story,

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. retell the story of Joseph interpreting a dream,
2. apply lessons learnt by depending on God’s wisdom,
3. recognise that, ‘the fear of God is the beginning of wisdom.’ The learner is guided to: try to interpret them, and colour it, How was Joseph able to interpret dreams?

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
